scripts.build: npm run build:atcoder && npm run build:zola && npm run build:ogp
scripts.build:zola: curl -sL https://github.com/getzola/zola/releases/download/v0.19.2/zola-v0.19.2-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar xz && ./zola build $(test "$WORKERS_CI_BRANCH" = main || echo --base-url /)
scripts.build:ogp: pip install playwright && playwright install --only-shell chromium && apt-get -o Dir::State=/tmp update && apt-get -o Dir::State=/tmp download libatk1.0-0t64 libatk-bridge2.0-0t64 libatspi2.0-0t64 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2t64 libxi6 && for d in *.deb; do dpkg -x $d /tmp/d; done && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/d/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu python generate_ogp.py
